Job_Description":"
This is a remote position.
We are seeking a AI Engineer (AI/ML) to join our team. You will develop, maintain, and improve a range of production AI/ML services that provide value to real users, using the best and most appropriate technologies from the rapidly evolving AI landscape. You will work closely with other AI engineers, software developers, systems engineers, product managers, and the UX team, among others, to help create AI-driven product features.



Responsibilities:



Using the latest AI technologies to power specific features in our products.

Evaluating, experimenting, and iterating on LLM prompts, agent workflows, and traditional ML models.

Monitoring and maintaining production models.

Working with Product and other Engineering teams to integrate our AI/ML features and services into our customer-facing products.

Providing tactical and strategic input on technical matters related to production AI/ML.

Learning new AI/ML techniques and best practices, and subject matter related to company business.

Working on a small, focused, awesome team to deliver outsized value to our customers using the latest AI/ML technologies.

Requirements
Strong foundation in AI/ML concepts, such as model evaluation.

Experience working with production AI/ML models.

Experience creating LLM-powered services and features.

Ability to write and maintain high quality code (Python) that is used by others.

Ability and desire to learn and implement new techniques, topics, and technologies.

2+ years of experience working in the software industry.

Nice To Have:



Experience with the end-to-end AI/ML process (ideation, creation, deployment, and maintenance of models) at scale.

Experience with multiple LLM models, tools, and best practices, including emerging agent paradigms.

Experience with document processing using LLMs.

Experience using AI-powered software development and the ability to separate the value from the hype.

Experience mentoring teammates.

Experience with the AWS AI/ML/LLM stack.

Experience with uv to manage Python projects.

Benefits
Work Location: Remote

5 days working
